title: WI-1 CoreDNS/etcd backend adapter
intended_behavior: Provide a CoreDNS backend adapter implementing the existing DNS Backend interface without app wiring changes.
Map FQDNs to CoreDNS etcd keys by reversing labels under the configured prefix.
Health verifies etcd connectivity through a narrow KV boundary.
ListRecords decodes CoreDNS JSON service payloads into domain DNS records.
SyncZone replaces only the target zone subtree through a single KV transaction boundary.
DNS backend config supports coredns etcd endpoints, prefix, and dial timeout validation.
observed_baseline: Only filesystem DNS backend adapter existed before WI-1.
DNSBackendConfig only supported type and root_dir before WI-1.
